review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in lost-target-rule.json. MEASURED: the twelve guided (LOCK_ON) ROCKET records of ZBD/zrdr.zbd weapons.zrd through cs_content::ordnance::read_original_rocket_blasts and OriginalRocketBlast::lost_target_rule (a lost target loses the DETONATION_DISTANCE proximity trigger; eleven keep only the end of RANGE, the flare wep_15 keeps only its 2 s DETONATION_TIME; no guided record declares EXPIRES so each detonates at the end of RANGE); and a byte scan of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (sha-256 recorded) showing the only stores to a projectile target pointer (+0x70) in the projectile module are the launch zeroing and the removed-object sweep clear, plus byte pins of the steering guard. The rule is per projectile (each projectile holds its own pointer; the sweep clears every matching one), the loss is terminal inside the module (no re-acquisition code there), and the first assignment of a target was not located. FIDELITY LIMITATIONS (unmeasured, none claimed): see the limitations array of lost-target-rule.json. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
